definition: Profit for the year after the cost of materials, staff, interest, equipment wear (depreciation), other costs and tax. It is not cash collected from customers.
sourceLabel: BSE-filed annual report 2025–26 · audited standalone financial statements
location: PDF page 72 · standalone statement of profit and loss, year ended 31 March 2026 column; PDF page 97 · note 24, revenue from operations; PDF pages 124–125 · consolidated statement for comparison
notes: Source figures are ₹ lakh and were divided by 100. Revenue is sale of goods only; it excludes other operating revenue (₹2.1392 crore) and other income (₹3.656 crore). The largest cost is materials: ₹480.7596 crore. Finance cost (interest and similar borrowing charges) rose to ₹39.2976 crore from ₹22.3766 crore a year earlier. Standalone figures are shown because the consolidated statement’s split of profit between owners and others does not add up to its own profit line; consolidated sales are the same and consolidated profit after tax is ₹32.6209 crore.
insight: Fredun’s sales were about 40% higher than a year earlier, and profit grew faster than sales. Most of each rupee of sales still goes on materials, so a small change in material costs or selling prices can move profit a lot.
